summary.name: LiveCode
summary.one_liner: LiveCode is a cross-platform software development environment, and this announcement says its open source Community edition is being discontinued in favor of paid monthly and subscription licensing.
use_cases: learning to code with a visual environment
summary.what_it_does: The page is a company announcement from LiveCode Ltd, not a product page. It says LiveCode has existed in various forms for about 30 years. The open source Community edition will no longer be maintained, and the open source Community Plus license is being discontinued. The source code remains viewable on GitHub, but the project will not accept contributions and will not offer open source downloads. The company is revising commercial subscription plans, with monthly pricing starting at $9.99 per month, and is retiring the Indy and Business license types. It also mentions release 9.6.4 (licensing changes), an upcoming 9.6.5 adding Android App Bundle and API30 support, and a planned LiveCode 10 with Web, media, camera, and mobile widget changes.
notable: Open source Community edition discontinued; source remains viewable on GitHub but no longer maintained
Upcoming LiveCode 10 with Web, media, camera and mobile widget changes
caveats: Open source Community edition and Community Plus license are discontinued; existing copies still usable but no further updates or downloads from the site
Indy and Business license types are no longer on sale
Paid subscription required for ongoing use of the commercial editions
